test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_array_join_key ( id UInt64, ids_bloom Array(String), ids_text Array(String), INDEX idx_ids_bloom ids_bloom TYPE bloom_filter(0.025) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_ids_text ids_text TYPE text(tokenizer = 'array') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE rf_array_join_key_lookup (v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY v
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_array_join_key SELECT number, [toString(number % 1000000), toString((number + 1) % 1000000)], [toString(number % 1000000), toString((number + 1) % 1000000)] FROM numbers(10000000)
INSERT INTO rf_array_join_key_lookup SELECT toString(number) FROM numbers(30)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM rf_array_join_key ARRAY JOIN ids_bloom AS src JOIN rf_array_join_key_lookup AS l ON src = l.v
SELECT count() FROM rf_array_join_key ARRAY JOIN ids_text AS src JOIN rf_array_join_key_lookup AS l ON src = l.v
SELECT count() FROM rf_array_join_key JOIN rf_array_join_key_lookup AS l ON arrayJoin(ids_text) = l.v
SELECT count() FROM rf_array_join_key ARRAY JOIN ids_bloom AS src JOIN (SELECT concat('x', v) AS v FROM rf_array_join_key_lookup) AS l ON src = l.v
